hero.title: About TATU Engineering School
hero.subtitle: Seventy years of engineering excellence, research leadership and national service — shaping the minds that drive Uzbekistan's digital future.

mvv.title: Our Mission
mvv.text: To provide world-class engineering education grounded in research and innovation — nurturing leaders who drive Uzbekistan's digital economy and contribute to global technological advancement.

mvv.title: Our Vision
mvv.text: To become a globally recognised engineering institution by 2030 — producing graduates who redefine technological boundaries and solve humanity's most pressing challenges.

mvv.title: Our Values
mvv.text: Excellence, integrity, innovation, inclusivity and service. We believe every student deserves the tools to succeed and every idea deserves to be heard.

hero.title: Academic Programs
hero.subtitle: From Bachelor to PhD — our programs are designed to prepare you for the world's most demanding engineering roles.

programs.emptyMsg: No programs available in this category yet.

list.title: Computer Science & Engineering
list.desc: Algorithms, artificial intelligence, machine learning and software engineering.
list.details: In this programme you will study modern programming languages, algorithms and the fundamentals of artificial intelligence. Led by Dean Prof. Akbar Toshmatov, over 4 years you will reinforce theoretical knowledge through real-world projects.

list.title: Computer Engineering
list.desc: Hardware-software integration, embedded systems and IoT applications.
list.details: The Computer Engineering programme focuses on the interface between hardware and software. You will learn to design microcontrollers, smart home systems and robotics devices.

list.title: Information Technology
list.desc: Enterprise systems, cloud architecture and cybersecurity.
list.details: As an IT specialist you will learn to build cloud systems for large enterprises, ensure data security and develop system administration skills.

list.title: Data Science
list.desc: Big data, statistical modelling and business intelligence.
list.details: In this programme led by Dr. Nilufar Yusupova you will learn data analysis and how to build predictive models. This is one of the most in-demand professions in today's market.

list.title: Electrical Engineering
list.desc: Power systems, signal processing and smart grids.
list.details: The Electrical Engineering programme covers renewable energy sources and telecommunications equipment. Under Prof. Sherzod Rakhimov you will gain deep expertise in Smart Grid technologies.

list.title: Artificial Intelligence
list.desc: Deep learning, NLP, computer vision and robotics research.
list.details: This is an advanced research programme intended only for Master's and PhD students. You will conduct experiments in laboratories covering neural networks, speech recognition and the design of autonomous robots.

hero.title: Our Faculty
hero.subtitle: 340+ world-class researchers, educators and industry experts — dedicated to knowledge and your growth.

list.name: Prof. Akbar Toshmatov
list.bio: Prof. Akbar Toshmatov is a specialist with over 20 years of experience. His research focuses on optimising AI algorithms in globally distributed systems. He is a speaker at numerous international IT conferences.

list.name: Dr. Nilufar Yusupova
list.bio: Dr. Nilufar Yusupova is a leading expert in Big Data and predictive analytics. Her research is dedicated to applying AI in medicine and building early disease-detection models.
list.education: PhD in Data Science, Stanford University

list.name: Prof. Sherzod Rakhimov
list.bio: Sherzod Rakhimov holds 15 patents in renewable energy and Smart Grid technologies. He leads projects on the digitalisation of power systems.
list.education: DSc in Electrical Engineering, ETH Zurich

list.name: Dr. Kamola Mirzayeva
list.bio: Dr. Mirzayeva is an expert in cryptography and cyber-attack prevention systems. She serves as a consultant developing security protocols for the banking and finance sector.
list.education: PhD in Cyber Security, Korea University

list.name: Prof. Otabek Nazarov
list.bio: Otabek Nazarov is a world-class researcher in microchip design and hardware security. Under his leadership the university's Robotics Laboratory was established.
list.education: PhD in Computer Engineering, TU Delft

list.name: Dr. Zulfiya Ergasheva
list.bio: Dr. Zulfiya Ergasheva teaches corporate cloud architecture and DevOps methodology. She has contributed to projects optimising large-scale government platforms.
list.education: PhD in Information Systems, National University of Singapore

hero.title: Admissions 2026
hero.subtitle: Begin your engineering journey. Applications for the 2026 academic year are now open.

list.title: Submit Application
list.desc: Complete the online application form with all personal and academic details.

list.title: Upload Documents
list.desc: Passport copy, academic transcript, language certificate (IELTS 6.0+) and motivation letter.

list.title: Entrance Exam
list.desc: Specialised test in mathematics and your chosen field. Top applicants are admitted based on prior academic performance.

list.title: Interview
list.desc: Shortlisted candidates attend a 30-minute online or in-person interview with the programme committee.

list.title: Receive Decision
list.desc: All applicants are notified of admission decisions via email and the application portal.

tuition.title: Tuition Fees
tuition.scholarship: Merit-based scholarships covering 50–100% of tuition fees are available
